free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: k.shape[2] is not fixed by the witness; equal to num_q_heads so the post-target GQA divisibility assert cannot fail

free_parameters.name: block_idx_ids
free_parameters.why: valid flattened block ids do not affect the length guard at the target; only the outer/inner list lengths matter

free_parameters.name: torch_seed
free_parameters.why: manifest seed; makes the CPU tensor construction deterministic

free_parameters.name: last_block_idx_heads
free_parameters.why: only used when batch_size>1; the extra negative makes the last batch group shorter than the first so block_idx[0] and block_idx[-1] differ

execution.entry_reason: flex_prefill_attention (call_chain[0]) has no block_idx parameter: it calls get_active_blocks, whose transform_veritcal_slash_idx builds the list as [ [unique(...) for h in range(num_heads)] for b in range(batch_size) ], with num_heads taken from q.shape[2]. Therefore len(block_idx) is always batch_size and len(block_idx[0]) is always num_q_heads, so neither half of the guard at line 1245 can fail through the official entry. The guard constrains a caller-supplied list[list[Tensor]] block_idx, so the driver calls call_chain[1] (triton_block_wise_attention), which forwards block_idx unchanged to the target function.
